items.text: Ian Rapoport on Reid's comments re Kenneth Walker groin: sounds like serious caution for KC.
items.why: Reid quotes on not doing something stupid while improving.
items.implication: High chance of another sit; monitor practice.
items.opportunity: Backup lead volume vs soft ARI run D.

items.text: Colts ruled out TE Will Mallory, OT Bernhard Raimann, DT Jerry Tillery, OT Jalen Travis and CB Charvarius Ward for TNF vs Texans.
items.implication: Tyler Warren more TE targets; OL issues may hurt JT slightly.
items.opportunity: Increased role for Warren at TE.

items.text: Adam Levitan agrees with Andy Reid that playing Kenneth Walker (groin) at less than 100% would be 'something stupid'; Chiefs are heavy home favorites vs ARI and have a huge Week 12 at BUF, so expect caution and possible sit.
items.why: Reid: sore groin getting better but don't do something stupid; Levitan notes schedule and Emmett Johnson's prior volume.
items.implication: Sit Walker; start handcuff if rostered as RB1 upside vs ARI.
items.opportunity: Full backfield snaps/carries/routes to backup if Walker inactive.

items.text: Context from reports: David Montgomery off injury report/expected clear for TNF; Woody Marks OUT concussion. (Aligned injury tracking)
Buccaneers QB Baker Mayfield did not practice Wednesday due to a foot injury.
items.implication: Trending toward sit; monitor for rookie start impact on TB skill players.
items.opportunity: If out, check backup QB and rush/pass game shift.

items.text: Matthew Berry: FULL CHUB(A) FOR MR. HUBBARD! Chuba Hubbard is my RB6 in rest-of-season rankings.
items.why: Strong volume and production hold with Brooks not a major threat.
items.implication: Start with confidence ROS; high trade value.
items.opportunity: Lead carries, goal-line, third-down in CAR offense.

items.text: No IR for Jordan Addison, per coach Kevin O’Connell.
items.why: O'Connell confirms not heading to IR.
items.implication: Could return sooner than multi-week IR; stash if dropped.
items.opportunity: Routes/targets back with Cousins elevating MIN pass game.

items.text: In first game with Kirk Cousins, Vikings set a season-high in Pass Rate Over Expectation. Clear Kevin O'Connell wants to throw a lot; boosts Justin Jefferson routes/targets.
items.why: Season-high PROE confirms pass-heavy intent with Cousins.
items.implication: Jefferson and MIN pass catchers upgraded ROS; favorable playoff DvP too.
items.opportunity: Increased routes, targets, air yards for Jefferson.

items.text: ETR notes NE loses Drake Maye, potentially for the season; Tommy DeVito to start amid hard-to-find positives for Patriots offense.
items.why: Fractured ankle concerns from Week 10; sources indicate extended/season miss.
items.implication: Drop or stash only in deep; NE pass catchers downgrade heavily.
items.opportunity: None for Maye; DeVito stream only desperation.

items.text: ETR/injury tracking: Brock Bowers ankle day-to-day after leaving early; potential 1-2 weeks, Mayer beneficiary.
items.why: Left early Week 10 ankle; bye later could extend sit.
items.implication: Monitor; if out Mayer TE1 upside.

items.text: Matthew Berry closing it out on Jalen Coker: talent there but fantasy production has not been.
Matthew Berry is CLOSING IT OUT on Jaylen Waddle. The target share is nice. The production is not.
items.why: Target share present but fantasy production lacking.
items.implication: Sit or trade; fade in rankings.

items.text: Lions placed EDGE Aidan Hutchinson on injured reserve and activated S Kerby Joseph from Reserve/PUP.
items.why: Season-ending ACL confirmed earlier; now official IR.
items.implication: Lions pass rush weakened; boost opposing QBs/OL slightly.

items.text: ETR has Jonathan Taylor ahead of Chase Brown in the ROS150 half-PPR. In full-PPR, Brown would be further ahead.
items.why: Updated ROS Top-150 half-PPR preference for JT.
items.implication: Prefer JT in half-PPR trades/starts; Brown edge in full PPR.
